about: Two planted defects, applied only to the benchmark copy of the source: an actor at a terminal crosses a person's DENY as if it were Orbit Control, and a forced push shares the fingerprint of the push it replaces.

mutations.find: return actor?.door === BOUNDARY_DOOR ? { allowed: true, by: "CONTROL", says: "a person, through Orbit Control" } : deniedHere(verdict, w);
